name: Sanjuusou
source:
Main character does not take classes seriously and skips them from time to time. In result he gets supplementary classes for three days at winter vacations. But during these days he meets three girls that make his heart beat faster.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-march-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角上课不认真，还时不时逃课，结果被安排在寒假补课三天。然而，就在这几天里，他邂逅了三位令自己心跳加速的女孩。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-march-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
